limitations: One game, one host and one compiler; background host load and CPU frequency vary.
Balanced run rotates case order; exploratory batches were sequential.
Maximum RSS is the largest individual child process, not aggregate concurrent memory.
Only native interface parsing is modularized; engine implementation files remain header-based.
production_pch_scope: Original game source include order, normal build plumbing, five additional PCH headers versus the prior common PCH; 12 warm edits and no-ops per case, alternating order over 6 rounds
reproducer_note: Published scripts add clean-worktree/input guards and remove an unused argument; bench_pch also removes an overwritten module hook. Timed commands and orderings are unchanged.

validation.gcc_15_pch_smoke: Built the final generated Hex PCH and compiled the real game source; -Werror=invalid-pch and -H confirmed GCC used the PCH. Compile-only, not a GCC module test.
